text:
```yaml
name: E2E Portal Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v2
        with:
          rust-version: stable

      - name: Set up Node.js (for Playwright)
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps

      - name: Build imix_connect with SOCKS5 UDP support
        run: cargo build --release --features socks5_udp

      - name: Run traffic verification script
        run: |
          if [ -f scripts/verify_traffic.sh ]; then
            bash scripts/verify_traffic.sh
          else
            echo "No traffic verification script found – skipping."
          fi

      - name: Run Playwright E2E tests
        run: npx playwright test
```
